15.02.
2023
CLR No.19 of 2023
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J. s
A decree was passed on 05.02.2019 in 
SCC Suit No.35 of 2015 on the basis of 
compromise. An Execution Case (No.09 of 
2020) is pending. An application under 
Section 47 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 
1908, was filed by the proposed revisionist. 
The said application has been dismissed by 
the impugned order dated 20.01.2023.
Heard Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned counsel 
for the proposed revisionist.
Learned counsel for the proposed 
revisionist submitted that learned Small 
Cause Court had no jurisdiction to try the said 
Suit.
In the facts and circumstances of this 
case, before admitting the revision, it is found 
appropriate to give an opportunity of hearing 
to the respondents.
Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned counsel for the 
proposed revisionist, requested for dasti 
notice.
Issue notice to the respondents through 
the Executing Court concerned as well as by 
dasti. Learned counsel for the proposed 
revisionist requested twenty four hours time 
to take steps.
List this case on 21.02.2023 as a fresh 
case.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
 15.02.2023
Pant/

23.02.2023 CLR No.19 of 2023
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Heard Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned 
counsel for the revisionist and Mr. 
Abhishek Grover, learned counsel 
appearing for the respondent no.1-
plaintiff.
Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate, 
submitted that a decree was passed on 
05.02.2019 in S.C.C. Suit No. 35 of 2015 
on the basis of compromise. An 
Execution Case No. 9 of 2020 is pending. 
An Application under Section 47 of the 
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 was filed 
by the revisionist. The said Application 
has been dismissed.
Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate, 
submitted that the Small Causes 
Court/IIIrd Additional District Judge, 
Dehradun, had no inherent jurisdiction to 
try the said S.C.C. Suit and to pass a 
compromise decree.
Learned counsel Mr. Abhishek 
Grover, Advocate, submitted that he has 
filed his Vakalatnama today itself and 
requested for 01.03.2023 for arguments. List this case on 01.03.2023 along 
with CLR No. 18 of 2023.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
 23.02.2023
